name: 1LYZ repaired, explicit nonpolar H (PDBFixer pH 7), OPLS-AA sigma/2 radii
volume_note: not computed; morphometry does not use it
radii_rule:
Explicit-hydrogen, OPLS-radius shapes of the lysozyme monomer and tetramer for
atom-type morphometry (Harano, Roth, Chiba 2013 geometry).

Heavy atoms: the repaired 1LYZ chain A positions of examples/monomer-shape.json (shape
frame), named by atom_types_monomer.json (1:1 order). Hydrogens: PDBFixer at pH 7
(OpenMM templates; His neutral, as in Harano et al.), placed at 1.09 A along the bond. Radii sigma/2 with OPLS-AA
Lennard-Jones sigma by chemical environment: aliphatic C 3.50, aromatic C 3.55,
carbonyl/carboxyl/guanidinium C 3.75, N 3.25, carbonyl O 2.96, hydroxyl O 3.12,
S 3.55, H on aliphatic C 2.50, H on aromatic C 2.42 A. Polar H (on N, O, S) have
sigma = 0 in OPLS-AA and get no sphere. Each H takes its parent's Harano type.
The tetramer shape repeats the monomer with the four rigid transforms recovered
from examples/tetramer-shape.json (Kabsch per copy).
Writes examples/{monomer,tetramer}-shape-opls-h.json and monomer-opls-h-harano-types.json.
